areas.name: Health (SUS)
areas.reason: New emergency unit and polyclinic widen specialties and attendance; objective relevant, but tiny resource share makes impact moderate and adherence limited.

areas.name: Early childhood and education
areas.reason: Revitalization of an education centre to cut the early-childhood vacancy deficit; small resource share and limited beneficiaries give low impact and restricted adherence.

areas.name: Sustainable cities
areas.reason: General objective directly aligned; most resources (about 70%) and most products go to integrated mobility, drainage, waste, urban requalification and parks; impact judged high.

areas.name: Public safety
areas.reason: Integrated operations centre enables real-time monitoring and coordination among agencies; very small resource share gives moderate impact and limited adherence.

areas.name: Environment
areas.reason: Specific objective on environmental preservation, with park revitalization and waste collection points, but only indirect relation, low impact and restricted adherence.

areas.name: Creative economy
areas.reason: No components, products, indicators or impacts directly tied to the area; central-area revitalization was credited under sustainable cities.

areas.name: Sport
areas.reason: Has a related objective and product, but no indicators or targets on sports access; the sports indicator was credited under early childhood and education.

areas.name: Disaster resilience and climate adaptation
areas.reason: River-bank containment and drainage works fit the area, but no indicators or targets on risk prevention; works were credited under sustainable cities.

areas.name: Water security
areas.reason: Flood-control and bank-stabilization works are urban drainage, not multiple-use water security; credited under sustainable cities.

areas.name: Tourism
areas.reason: Park and central-area works may affect tourism only indirectly and are not aimed at tourism service quality; credited under sustainable cities.

areas.name: Regional equity
areas.reason: No evidence the mobility axis targets territorial equity or vulnerable regions; its mobility benefit was credited under sustainable cities.

areas.name: Digital government
areas.reason: Has an aligned objective and a product modernizing municipal IT and data protection compliance, but no indicators or targets on digital transformation.
